name: The Exchange
subtitle: Ta Monument
ability: ACTION: Exhaust this card and remove 1 attachment from a non-home planet you control in or adjacent to this system and attach it to another non-home planet you control in or adjacent to this system that does not already have one.

name: Hearth-Home
subtitle: Ashen Monument
ability: When 1 or more of your infantry is destroyed during ground combat in a system in or adjacent to this unit’s planet, you may place up to 1 of those infantry on a planet in this unit’s system.

name: The Glassway
subtitle: Crystellum Monument
ability: ACTION: Exhaust this card and return 3 captured fighters from your faction sheet to the supply to ready 1 planet you control in or adjacent to this system.

name: Plateau of Leng
subtitle: Dreaming Monument
ability: This unit is placed in the space area of a system containing your ships. If this unit is blockaded, it is destroyed. After 1 or more of your ships in an adjacent system are destroyed, you may exhaust this card to place that ship in this unit’s system.

name: The Breaker's Yard
subtitle: Iron Monument
ability: When another player uses PRODUCTION in an adjacent system, that player may choose to give you 1 trade good to apply +1 to their total PRODUCTION value and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 2.

name: Ghost Protocol
subtitle: Net-Runners Monument
ability: When another player plays an action card during a combat in or adjacent to this system, you may exhaust this card and return 1 of that player's control tokens from your faction sheet to their reinforcements to cancel that action card.

name: Amaluun's Blessing
subtitle: Natau Monument
ability: After another player activates a non-home system containing an anomaly in or adjacent to this system, that player may give you 1 trade good to ignore the effects of that anomaly during this tactical action.

name: Himinbjörg
subtitle: Valhavn Monument
ability: When you activate a system adjacent to this unit’s system, you may move 1 of your PDS from a planet adjacent to this system onto this unit’s planet. Your infantry may be placed onto this unit’s planet when resolving their text ability.

name: The Cyst
subtitle: Mi-Go Monument
ability: At the end of your tactical action in this or an adjacent system, you may exhaust this card and remove 1 of your infantry from a planet you control in the active system to explore that planet.

name: Ether Anchor
subtitle: Deep Monument
ability: This unit is placed in the The Deep unit’s system. When The Deep unit moves, this unit moves with it. If this unit is blockaded, destroy it. After a space combat in this unit’s system, you may exhaust this card to repair The Deep.

name: Symbiote
subtitle: J'nahfa Monument
ability: After another player exhausts a planet containing your coexisting ground forces in or adjacent to this system, you may exhaust this card; that player may ready that planet. If they do, place 1 infantry from your reinforcements into coexistence on that planet.

name: Silent Soliloquy
subtitle: Ossyra Monument
ability: At the end of another player's tactical action in an adjacent system, you may exhaust this card. That player may repair 1 of their damaged ships in the active system. If they do, you may damage or repair 1 of your ships in this system.
